topic: From Lengthy to Lucid: A Systematic Literature Review on NLP Techniques for Taming Long Sentences
topic_definition: Stage 2 canonical eligibility, source-faithful to the original paper's screening criteria. Eligible studies are original works about dealing with long sentences through sentence summarization, sentence compression, sentence splitting, split-and-rephrase, or related sentence-level transformations.
summary: Stage 2 canonical criteria restated from criteria_mds/2312.05172.md; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2312.05172.json.

summary_topics.description: From Lengthy to Lucid: A Systematic Literature Review on NLP Techniques for Taming Long Sentences

required.criterion: Paper is an original work concerning the task of dealing with long sentences, such as sentence summarization, sentence compression, sentence splitting, or split-and-rephrase.
Paper is a journal publication or conference publication.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Studies published prior to 2017 are excluded if they have fewer than 10 citations in total.
